decisions.decision:
Build T-265 end to end on a branch off main, then merge and push.
1) cloud/src/dashboard.ts collectDash: remove the via!=="tantra" skip. Read Tantra GET /campaigns/:id/stats and GET /dashboard/calendar-metrics, and Metricool post analytics (clicks). Use the attendee's stored keys. Missing key or error shows "not connected", never a planned count. Add a probe with simulated responses.

3) Pack-side check that each d3-connect MCP responds, plus an ICS download for build hours using the start-calendar code.
4) Mark X019, X074, X078–X081 fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit, then move the task to review.
